name: PromptRegistryTab

states.name: Version History List

requiredElements.text: No versions recorded for this template yet.

states.description: The version history list shows all versions for a prompt template sorted by version number descending. Each version row shows the version number badge (v1, v2...), the change description, a truncated SHA256 content hash, and the creation date. The list header displays a count of versions and provides Compare and Refresh controls. In compare mode, two versions can be selected as A and B with highlighted selection indicators.
states.precondition: At least one prompt variant exists with at least 2 versions

states.name: Version Detail View

requiredElements.text: Create new version with this content?

states.description: The version detail view shows the full prompt content, metadata, performance metrics, and a 'Restore this version' button. It displays the version number, creation timestamp, truncated content hash, change description, and the full prompt content in a scrollable pre block. Performance metrics show success rate, average cost, and average latency when available.
states.precondition: At least one prompt variant exists with at least 2 versions

states.name: Version Comparison
states.description: The version comparison feature allows users to view a unified or side-by-side diff between two selected versions. Compare mode allows selecting two versions as A and B. The diff view parses unified diff output into addition (green), deletion (red), context, and header lines. Two view modes are available: 'Inline' and 'Side-by-side'.
states.precondition: At least one prompt variant exists with at least 2 versions

states.name: Canary A/B Testing

requiredElements.text: No prompt canary A/B tests found. Create one to compare prompt versions.

states.description: The PromptCanaryPanel displays active and completed prompt canary A/B tests. Each canary card shows the status badge, template ID, version comparison (baseline vs candidate), traffic percentage, and a metrics comparison grid with Success Rate, Avg Cost, Avg Latency, and Delta columns. Statistical evaluation shows the p-value, verdict (promote/rollback/keep/pending), and total runs. Active canaries display a progress bar toward the minimum 20 candidate runs needed for a verdict.
states.precondition: An active prompt canary exists with at least one recorded run

states.name: Canary Creation
states.description: The CreatePromptCanaryForm allows users to set up a new prompt canary A/B test. The form has fields for Template ID, Baseline Version, Candidate Version, and a Candidate Traffic percentage slider (1-100%). When opened from a prompt variant, the template ID and baseline version are pre-filled.
states.precondition: At least one prompt variant exists in the registry

states.name: Canary Lifecycle
states.description: Active canary tests have Promote and Rollback action buttons that control the canary lifecycle. Promoting a canary makes the candidate version the new active version. Rolling back reverts to the baseline. The PromptRegistryTab integrates both features: each expanded prompt variant has a 'Version History' button and a 'Create A/B Test' button. The canary panel at the top of the registry shows all canaries across templates.

states.name: Navigation
states.description: Navigation flows between the prompt registry, version history, version detail, diff view, and canary creation form. Users navigate via buttons that toggle inline panels or switch between list/detail/diff sub-views within PromptVersionHistory.

states.name: State Consistency
states.description: Assertions verifying that displayed state remains internally consistent: version numbering is sequential, current-version indicators match, diff stats are accurate, canary metrics update correctly, and statistical values converge as expected.

states.name: Element Presence
states.description: Assertions verifying that required UI elements are present in each view: version row metadata, diff line numbers, canary action buttons, metrics grid columns, and registry variant action buttons.

description: The Prompt Registry manages prompt template versioning with diff comparison, and canary A/B test deployments that split traffic between baseline and candidate prompt versions to evaluate performance via statistical analysis. Backend: 6 prompt version endpoints, PromptTemplateVersion model with SHA256 content hashing, PromptTemplateCanary in SQLite+PG with proportion_analysis statistics.
